career.dialogDescription: Pick a unit for each level, the manager, employment type and the date the position starts. Adding a position closes the previous one the day before.
career.noLevels: Hierarchy levels could not be loaded; viewing the company structure requires organization read access.
career.validFromHint: The previous record is closed the day before this date.
career.validFromLocked: Only the latest record can change its start date.
career.deleteDescription: The record is deleted and the previous position becomes current again.

validation.validFromAfterPrevious: The date must be after the previous record's start ({{date}}).
validation.validFromBeforeHire: The date cannot be before the hire date ({{date}}).

workSchedule.title: Work schedule history
workSchedule.assignDescription: Add a work schedule assignment for {{name}}. Leaving the end date empty makes it the current assignment.
workSchedule.scheduleRequired: A work schedule must be selected.
workSchedule.effectiveToBeforeFrom: End date cannot be before start date.
workSchedule.activeLimit: Only one active work schedule assignment is allowed at a time.
workSchedule.deleteDescription: The work schedule assignment starting on {{date}} will be deleted.

payments.noAccess: You are not allowed to view this employee's payment information.

salary.dialogDescription: A new salary becomes the current one from its effective date; earlier records stay in the history.
salary.noCurrent: No salary is in effect today; all records are future-dated.
salary.integrityHint: Currency, salary type, pay frequency and allowances are not saved without an effective date and an amount.
salary.deleteDescription: The salary record of {{amount}} effective {{date}} will be deleted.

validation.amountInvalid: The salary amount must be a number greater than zero with at most two decimals.
validation.allowanceInvalid: Transport and meal allowances must be zero or positive numbers with at most two decimals.
validation.duplicateDate: A salary record effective {{date}} already exists.

bank.title: Bank accounts
bank.dialogDescription: Type the IBAN with or without spaces; its check digits are verified as you type.
bank.ibanMaskedHint: You are not allowed to see the full IBAN. Type a new IBAN to replace it; leave it blank to keep the current one.
bank.deleteDescription: The account will be deleted permanently.
bank.deletePrimaryDescription: This is the primary account. If deleted, the oldest remaining account becomes primary.

validation.invalid: The IBAN is invalid; check its length (TR + 24 digits) and check digits.
validation.countryUnsupported: Only IBANs starting with TR are accepted for now.

union.officerHint: Union office is a reason to suspend the employee.

subcontractor.title: Subcontractor
subcontractor.hint: Pick the company when the employee works for a subcontractor; leave empty for your own staff.

suspend.title: Suspend employee
suspend.description: A suspended employee is not counted in the active headcount; the login account is not touched.

reactivate.title: Reactivate employee
reactivate.description: {{name}} will be set back to active.

terminate.title: Termination
terminate.description: The reason pre-fills the termination type and the SGK exit code. The type stays editable; the SGK exit code comes from the reason's verified code table and is read-only.
terminate.typeHint: Left empty, the reason's default applies.
terminate.sgkExitCodeHint: Comes from the verified SGK code table for the chosen reason and termination type; changing the type updates the code. Read-only.
terminate.sgkSubCodeHint: This reason has more than one valid SGK code - pick one.
terminate.sgkSubCodeRequired: Pick an SGK sub-code for this reason.

severanceEstimate.title: Severance/notice estimate
severanceEstimate.immoralOrBadFaith: Termination for violating rules of morality and good faith (İş K. m.25/II)
severanceEstimate.unavailable: The estimate cannot be calculated right now (a current salary record is required).
severanceEstimate.disclaimer: This is an estimate only; kötüniyet/union compensation is out of scope and nothing is recorded.

terminate.severancePaidHint: When paid, this period does not count towards severance seniority after a rehire.
terminate.leaveSettled: Annual leave used up or paid out
terminate.leaveSettledHint: When ticked, this period does not count towards leave seniority after a rehire.
terminate.openAssetsWarning: This employee still has {{count}} unreturned asset(s). The exit can still be completed - remember to record the return from the "Assets" tab.
terminate.dateBeforeHire: The termination date cannot be before the hire date ({{date}}).
terminate.reviewDescription: Check one last time before terminating: the details below and the SGK exit code will be recorded.
terminate.confirmSgkExitCode: I confirm the SGK exit code

rehire.title: Rehire employee

rehire.dateBeforeExit: The new hire date must be after the previous exit date ({{date}}).
rehire.success: The employee is rehired. Leave accrual starts on {{date}}.

exitSettlement.title: Exit settlement
exitSettlement.hint: Amounts calculated at exit plus lines added since. Severance, notice and leave are frozen at exit; later salary or legislation changes do not affect them.
exitSettlement.netPending: The net could not be calculated (a legislation parameter may be missing). Try recalculating.
exitSettlement.estimateNote: Deductions are an estimate; the tax and SGK treatment of mutual-termination payments and extra payments depends on the contract. Confirm with an accountant before paying out.
